messages:
alice.k: Creating RC build for the 2.3.1 feature set. tagging candidate as rc-2.3.1-2024-11
ben_p: thanks — what's the plan for canary traffic and rollback windows?
alice.k: aim is 5% canary for 30m then 25% for 30m then full if all green. rollback window: first 2 hours full attention, SLA for rollback decision 15m.
maria_qa: will run smoke and the regression suite on canary once deploy finishes. ETA ~10m.
deploy-bot: Build artifact created: sha256:8f3a2c... pinned as rc-2.3.1-2024-11 to staging and canary namespaces. CI: all green except flaky e2e-logging (warn).
carol_q: noted flaky logging — we shouldn't block rollout for that if it's non-customer impacting. recommend proceed with canary and monitor errors.
oncall-jordan: @alice.k make sure the highway monitor alert for latency is on and the data retention is 72h for this promo. I'll be watching.
ben_p: add a safety latch: if token latency 95th > 500ms for 3m, automated traffic cut to fallback model. Also if error rate > 1% absolute, cut.
alice.k: added policy in deploy config:
```
traffic_policy:
  canary:
    steps: [5,25,70]
    hold_minutes: [30,30,30]
  fallbacks:
    - condition: 'p50_latency > 500ms for 180s'
      action: revert-to: stable-2.3
    - condition: 'error_rate > 1.0% over 3m'
      action: revert-to: stable-2.3
```
carol_q: looks good. Maria, if smoke fails please post exactly which assertion failed and tag me.
maria_qa: running smoke now...
maria_qa: smoke passed, but regression: embeddings mismatch in 1 test (threshold drift). details: expected cos sim > 0.85 got 0.78 on sample set id=emb-2024-11-rc.
ben_p: hmm — embedding drift could be model variant/quantization. Is this on only long inputs?
maria_qa: appears to be mid-length (200-300 tokens). sampling more now.
oncall-jordan: let's not escalate yet. if it's a quality regression on an internal eval only, we can proceed but create a quality rollback ticket and plan a fast hotfix.
alice.k: propose proceed with canary to validate real traffic signals, but pin traffic step 1 to 2% not 5% for the first 15m, then move to 10% for 15m before 25%. gives us more control.
ben_p: agree. reduce initial blast radius. I'll update the deploy gate.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: rc-2.3.1-2024-11 -> canary group A (2%), metadata: {artifact: "sha256:8f3a2c...", owner: "alice.k"}.
maria_qa: initial canary telemetry: p95 latency 210ms, error rate 0.12%, embeddings drift: sample size 40, avg cos sim 0.80 vs baseline 0.86.
carol_q: noise expected at small sample. can you run full eval on live sampling endpoints for next 20m?
maria_qa: doing it now.
ben_p: reminder: pin the promoted artifact in repo. don't allow hotfix-promote without explicit signoff.
alice.k: pinned in release registry: rc-2.3.1-2024-11 -> artifact sha256:8f3a2c... ; tag: release-candidate. documented in release_notes/rc-2.3.1-2024-11.md (link internal).
oncall-jordan: alert: autoscaler spike on worker pool - added temporary cap to avoid noisy neighbors. watching.
maria_qa: live sampling for embeddings shows avg cos sim 0.84 over 200 samples now; trending closer to baseline. false alarm likely from small sample. no functional customer-facing regressions found.
carol_q: great. can we lift to 25% per the earlier plan?
alice.k: moving to 10% -> deploy-bot: increasing canary to 10%.
deploy-bot: Canary update: canary group A -> 10% applied.
ben_p: monitor the rollout checks for 30m. we hold on full promotion until 60m of steady signals (latency, errors, quality evals).
maria_qa: 30m telemetry: p95 230ms, error rate 0.08%, embeddings avg 0.857 — within acceptable delta.
oncall-jordan: thumbs up from oncall. I'll keep the pager window at high sensitivity for 2h.
alice.k: preparing promo checklist: 1) docs updated, 2) release notes drafted, 3) rollback plan clear, 4) cust-facing experiments flagged.
carol_q: add a dev-experiments flag to opt-out for the new model in prod for key customers if needed.
alice.k: done. drafted release notes: short blurb + known issue about logging flakiness and embedding float drift investigation.
ben_p: decision: promote at T+90m if no regression. otherwise roll to stable-2.3.
maria_qa: still green at T+60m.
deploy-bot: Canary at 25% (step 2) applied. monitoring now.
ben_p: final checkins please: infra, SRE, QA.
oncall-jordan: infra ok. SRE monitors in place.
carol_q: QA signoff: minor drift tracked in ticket Q-987. not blocking.
alice.k: doing promotion to 100% now.
deploy-bot: Promotion started: rc-2.3.1-2024-11 -> prod. rolling to 100% in 3 waves.
maria_qa: quick smoke post-promo: all green. embeddings eval on 1k sample: avg 0.86.
ben_p: update release registry to final: release-2.3.1 promoted from rc-2.3.1-2024-11.
oncall-jordan: no critical alerts. good job team.
carol_q: logging flakiness follow-up: assign to infra and put backport if needed.
alice.k: closing thread, will file postmortem notes if anything pops in next 24h. :tada:
ben_p: :shipit:
deploy-bot: Deployment complete: rc-2.3.1-2024-11 -> prod success. audit id: deploy-8347.
